name: Crank drive Y
description: The Y half of the circular drive that Crank drive X describes, and it must be used with it. It acts on the target's Y position directly: Y changes at Angular velocity × (target X − source X). Apply it between the same pivot and crank pin as Crank drive X. Angular velocity (rad/s, default 1, live) is how fast the pin turns about the pivot, counter-clockwise when X points right and Y up. It must equal the value on Crank drive X, or the pin stops moving in a circle: link the two to one shared parameter in the Parameters table so they cannot differ.
